brief_summary: Four-panel process strip showing the firmware decision loop that reruns on every poll: poll (sample analog travel distance), track (update the running peak reached since the last release), compare (coral-emphasized — current distance vs. peak minus the reset delta, the only real decision), emit (actuate or release event to the host).
data_sources: rapid-trigger-firmware-deep-dive.mdx § 'The loop: tracking the peak, not a fixed point' — 'the firmware keeps exactly one extra piece of state beyond the current position: the deepest point that key has reached since it last registered a release — the running peak of the current stroke. Every poll runs the same three-step comparison.'
